definitions.concentration: HHI and top-5 share of PIT caps on d over priced members; NULL unless every priced member has a PIT cap
definitions.cw_return_Kd: trailing returns weighted by PIT market cap at d-K; NULL below 90% cap coverage or without PIT caps
definitions.dispersion_Kd: sample standard deviation of member trailing simple returns (>= 2 members)
definitions.held_ew_return_Kd: equal-weight portfolio formed at d-K from members eligible at d-K, held to d; names that left membership inside the window (delisting or reclassification) exit at their last available close, then cash; names without a terminal close are excluded and counted
definitions.members: symbols eligible on the decision date with a classification effective on that date; no later information
definitions.pct_above_Wd: share of members whose close exceeds the simple moving average of their last W session closes; denominator = members with W complete closes
definitions.trailing_returns: simple returns close_d / close_(d-K) - 1 of decision-time members (trailing statistics, not a held portfolio)

not_research_evidence: descriptive aggregates for the DB-only dashboard; no strategy, no economic pass, no holdout access
